stories.title: Ground stop canceled at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport due to wind
stories.summary: The ground stop was issued just before 7 p.m. and was canceled around 7:45 p.m.

stories.title: Coastal flooding possible in areas of western Washington
stories.summary: Storm surge and tidal overflows could lead to flooding in various parts of western Washington Thursday, according to the National Weather Service.

stories.title: Tacoma officer shoots, kills attempted murder suspect
stories.summary: Tacoma officers attempted to arrest a suspect when the shooting occurred on Wednesday night at a Fife hotel.

stories.title: Seattle, King County join efforts to stop ban on transgender athletes in girls' sports
stories.summary: The City of Seattle and King County filed a joint amicus brief on Tuesday in support of the state’s ongoing lawsuit against the initiative.

stories.title: 1 dead, 4 hurt in crash near Roy
stories.summary: The two-vehicle collision occurred Wednesday evening along state Route 702 and 40th Avenue South near Roy, according to first responders.

stories.title: Tacoma residents prepare for potential coastal flooding
stories.summary: A king tide briefly covered part of the walkway at Tacoma’s Owen Beach on Wednesday morning.

stories.title: Seattle food bank sees record demand amid Thanksgiving distribution in Chinatown-International District
stories.summary: Food distribution began ahead of schedule at the Asian Counseling and Referral Service food bank to meet demand on Wednesday.

stories.title: 'It looks intentional': Headless sea lion found on West Seattle boat ramp
stories.summary: A headless California sea lion washed ashore at a West Seattle boat ramp and wildlife experts suspect a person removed its head, a possible violation of federal law.

stories.title: Urgent repairs at Vashon ferry terminal could delay Thanksgiving travel
stories.summary: Four of the terminal's six lanes will close Sunday morning as crews replace rotting wooden pilings beneath the ferry dock.

stories.title: Environmental group sues King County over nitrogen, phosphorus from West Point treatment plant
stories.summary: Nitrogen and phosphorus act like fertilizer in water, feeding algae that use up oxygen. A new lawsuit says West Point releases them unchecked.

stories.title: Whatcom County slowly making progress on flood protection as another winter looms
stories.summary: Sumas has seen two historic floods in four years. Whatcom County says it's making progress, but there's no timeline for a comprehensive plan.

stories.title: Tacoma police investigate homicide after man found with signs of trauma
stories.summary: Police said they found a deceased man with signs of trauma when responding to reports of a person on the ground.
